prompt.en: Meera lives with her papa and her dadi. Is that a family? Why?
prompt.hi: Meera apne papa aur dadi ke saath rehti hai. Kya yeh family hai? Kyun?

challenges.hint: Do Meera, her papa and dadi look after each other?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'A family must always have a mummy, a papa and two children — otherwise it is not a family.' Is that right?
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Family mein hamesha mummy, papa aur do bachche hone chahiye — warna woh family nahi hai.' Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Remember Zoya with her nani and mother.

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'The giant wheel at the mela runs all by itself; nobody has to work there.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Mele ka giant wheel apne aap chalta hai; wahan kisi ko kaam nahi karna padta.'

challenges.hint: Who checks that riders are safe?

prompt.en: Say the lost-child plan in three steps.
prompt.hi: Kho jaane wala plan 3 steps mein batao.

challenges.hint: Then who do you look for?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'If a stranger knows your name, they must know your family, so it's safe to go with them.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Agar koi anjaan insaan tumhara naam jaanta hai, toh woh zaroor tumhari family ko jaanta hoga, toh uske saath jaana safe hai.'

challenges.hint: Is your name written on anything you carry?

prompt.en: Guess: Diwali is celebrated in many states. Do you think every state celebrates it in exactly the same way?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: Diwali kai states mein manaayi jaati hai. Kya har state mein bilkul ek jaisi manaayi jaati hogi?

challenges.hint: Have you heard of Kali Puja in Bengal?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'When the traffic light turns yellow, the driver should speed up to cross before it goes red.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Jab batti peeli ho jaaye, toh driver ko tez chala ke red hone se pehle nikal jaana chahiye.'

challenges.hint: Who might be starting to cross?

prompt.en: You find a plant on a damp wall with feathery leaves and little brown dots under the leaves, but no flowers at all. Can it still be a plant?
prompt.hi: Ek geeli deewar pe tumhe ek paudha milta hai — pankh jaise patte, patton ke neeche chhote bhoore dots, par phool bilkul nahi. Kya yeh phir bhi paudha hai?

challenges.hint: Do all plants need flowers?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Plants eat soil through their roots — soil is their food.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Paudhe jadon se mitti khaate hain — mitti hi unka khaana hai.'

challenges.hint: Which part makes food, and with what?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Grass is not a plant because it is so small and has no flowers.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Ghaas paudha nahi hai kyunki woh bahut chhoti hai aur uspe phool nahi aate.'

challenges.hint: Does being small stop something being a plant?

prompt.en: Before we start: if you sat still near one tree for 10 minutes, how many different kinds of creatures do you guess you'd spot — fewer than 3, about 5, or more than 5? Count the tiny ones too.
prompt.hi: Shuru karne se pehle: agar tum ek ped ke paas 10 minute chupchaap baitho, toh kitni alag-alag tarah ke jeev dikhenge — 3 se kam, lagbhag 5, ya 5 se zyada? Chhote-chhote jeev bhi gino.

challenges.hint: Have you counted the ants and spiders?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Only big animals like monkeys and birds live in trees; ants and spiders don't count as animals.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Pedon mein sirf bade jaanwar jaise bandar aur panchhi rehte hain; cheenti aur makdi toh jaanwar hote hi nahi.'

challenges.hint: What makes something an animal?

prompt.en: From last time: is an earthworm an insect? Why or why not?
prompt.hi: Pichhli baar ki baat: kya kenchua insect hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?

challenges.hint: How many does an earthworm have?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Flowers make fruits all by themselves; bees just come to steal the nectar.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Phool apne aap phal bana lete hain; madhumakkhiyaan toh bas ras churaane aati hain.'

challenges.hint: Remember what happened to the no-bee pumpkin field.

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Water comes from the tap, so we can never run out of it.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Paani nal se aata hai, isliye yeh kabhi khatam nahi ho sakta.'

challenges.hint: What happens when the river or ground water runs low?

prompt.en: An ice cube on a plate turns into water. Sugar stirred into water disappears from view. Are these the same thing happening? What's the difference?
prompt.hi: Plate pe rakha barf ka tukda paani ban jaata hai. Paani mein ghuli cheeni dikhna band ho jaati hai. Kya dono mein ek hi cheez ho rahi hai? Farak kya hai?

challenges.hint: Is the sugar still there? How could you check?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'This pond water looks clear and clean, so it's fine to drink straight away.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Yeh talaab ka paani saaf dikh raha hai, toh seedha pee sakte hain.'

challenges.hint: Can you see germs?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Milk is made in the dairy factory — that's where it comes from.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Doodh dairy ki factory mein banta hai — wahin se aata hai.'

challenges.hint: What does the dairy actually do?

prompt.en: Guess first: if you go to a fruit market in May, which will you see piled high — mangoes or oranges?
prompt.hi: Pehle guess karo: May mein phal mandi jaoge toh kiske dher lage honge — aam ya santre?

challenges.hint: Which fruit is the king of summer?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'People in Tamil Nadu and Punjab eat the same foods, because they are both in India.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Tamil Nadu aur Punjab ke log ek jaisa khaana khaate hain, kyunki dono India mein hain.'

challenges.hint: Think of idli and paratha.

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Just splashing water on your hands for a second removes all the germs.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Haathon pe ek second paani ke chheente maaro, saare keetanu chale jaate hain.'

challenges.hint: How long should you rub with soap?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'If you smell gas, quickly switch on the light so you can find where it's leaking.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Agar gas ki smell aaye toh jaldi se light jalao taaki leak dikh jaaye.'

challenges.hint: What does gas need to catch fire?

prompt.en: From last time: does a magnet stick to aluminium foil?
prompt.hi: Pichhli baar ka sawaal: kya magnet aluminium foil pe chipakta hai?

challenges.hint: Aluminium is a metal, but…

prompt.en: Your mother wants a curtain that keeps the room dark in the afternoon for the baby's nap. Should the curtain be transparent, translucent or opaque?
prompt.hi: Mummy aisa parda chaahti hain jisse dopahar mein baby ki neend ke liye kamra andhera rahe. Parda transparent, translucent ya opaque hona chahiye?

challenges.hint: Thin or thick cloth?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Thin things always let light pass through, and thick things never do.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Patli cheezon mein se hamesha roshni paar hoti hai, aur moti cheezon mein se kabhi nahi.'

challenges.hint: Which one was thin? Which let light through?

prompt.en: From last time: is butter paper transparent, translucent or opaque?
prompt.hi: Pichhli baar ka sawaal: butter paper transparent hai, translucent ya opaque?

challenges.hint: But can you see clearly through it?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'Potters dry pots in the sun and that's it — baking is just to make them look red.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Kumhaar ghade dhoop mein sukhaate hain, bas — pakaana toh sirf unhe laal dikhane ke liye hota hai.'

challenges.hint: So what does baking really do?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake. I made a border: fish, flower, fish, flower, flower, fish, flower. I say it's a perfect pattern. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo. Maine border banaaya: machhli, phool, machhli, phool, phool, machhli, phool. Main kehti hoon yeh perfect pattern hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Check each place one by one.

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'A wet newspaper goes in the wet bin, and dry orange peels go in the dry bin.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Geela akhbaar geele dabbe mein jaata hai, aur sookhe santre ke chhilke sookhe dabbe mein.'

challenges.hint: Which one will rot?

prompt.en: Catch my mistake: 'The easiest way to get rid of plastic waste is to burn it — then it's gone.'
prompt.hi: Meri galti pakdo: 'Plastic ka kachra hatane ka sabse aasaan tareeka hai use jala do — phir woh khatam.'

challenges.hint: What would that smoke do to our lungs?
